---
title: Deploy by hand
guide-section: Use it
---

Optional. Deploy from your own computer instead of the workflow. Useful without a runner, or to test a change.

Needs: `git`, `ssh`, `rsync` and `python3` on your computer, and passwordless SSH to Home Assistant. See [Install the add-ons](add-ons.qmd).

## Steps

1. Clone ha-automations and check out the release to deploy:

   ```sh
   git clone https://github.com/joshwlivingston/ha-automations
   cd ha-automations
   git checkout v0.1.0
   ```

2. Create `.deploy.env` in that folder:

   ```sh
   HA_SSH=root@homeassistant.local
   APPS_YAML=../ha-automations-config/apps.yaml
   REPO_URL=https://github.com/joshwlivingston/ha-automations
   ```

3. Deploy:

   ```sh
   scripts/deploy.sh
   ```

To deploy another release, check it out and run the script again.

The script prints the command to read the AppDaemon log when it finishes.

## Settings

Set these in `.deploy.env` or as environment variables.

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `HA_SSH` | Required | SSH login, e.g. `root@homeassistant.local` |
| `APPS_YAML` | Required | Path to your `apps.yaml`. Relative paths start from the ha-automations folder, not your config repo. |
| `REPO_URL` | Required | Where to install from, e.g. `https://github.com/joshwlivingston/ha-automations` |
| `HA_SSH_PORT` | `22` | SSH port |
| `ADDON_SLUG` | `a0d7b954_appdaemon` | AppDaemon add-on ID. Change only if you installed AppDaemon from another add-on store. |
| `APPS_DIR` | The AppDaemon add-on's `apps` folder | Where `apps.yaml` goes on the box |
| `DEV` | Unset | `1` allows test builds (`vX.Y.Z.9NNN`). Test builds are not releases. |
| `FORCE` | Unset | `1` deploys even if the box already runs this release and `apps.yaml` |
| `NO_RESTART` | Unset | `1` skips the AppDaemon restart and prints the command to restart later |
